text:
maya: kicking off SAO (sa-east1) cluster bring-up thread — want to validate registry replication, gitops sync, GPU driver + nodepool sizing, and a clean handoff checklist. pinging infra owners.
trent: on it. I pushed the initial gitops PR to git@github.com:redwood-infra/regions.git in `sa-east1/bootstrap`. flux should pick it up.
lina: FYI registry replication needs an allowlist for the geo-rep proxy — firewall rule is currently blocking 34.95.*/32 egress from our replication runner.
arjun: noted. I'll open a cloud firewall change: allow egress to registry-replica.sa-east1.redwood-registry.internal:443 from 10.12.0.0/24. Expect ~5 min.
suhas: for GPU sizing — recommended nodepool: n1-highmem-8 + 1xA100 per node is overkill. Suggest a mix: k80-style cheaper for batch workloads and a small A100 pool for latency-sensitive. We can start with 4 gpus total (2 a100, 2 t4) and scale via autoscaler.
maya: good call. add cost note: A100 on-demand in sa-east1 is pricey — consider committed use for Dedicated customers. Add that to handoff.
trent: flux reported initial kustomize apply succeeded. deploy-bot: "flux sync triggered: repo=regions branch=main path=clusters/sa-east1 status=ok"
lina: registry-replicator job failed on first run — 403 when trying to pull images from gcr-us. Error: "manifest unknown" for some multi-arch manifests. Likely need to enable cross-region manifest replication and set platform filtering.
arjun: workaround: run regsync with --platform=linux/amd64,linux/arm64 and force-manifest-copy. I'll run a one-off.
suhas: also run a quick GPU smoke test once nodes are ready:
```
# smoke-gpu-check.sh
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide
kubectl describe node $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o name | head -n1)
kubectl run --rm -it --restart=Never gpu-test --image=nvidia/cuda:11.7-base --limits=resources.requests.nvidia.com/gpu=1 -- bash -lc "nvidia-smi && python -c 'import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())'"
```
maya: nice. add to runbook: verify nvidia driver version >= 525, check kubelet device plugin healthy.
trent: regsync finished with forced-manifest-copy, 42 images replicated. I added a TTL cache in front of the replica registry to reduce egress while warm-up runs.
lina: remote image pull latency is ~1200ms for first cold pulls. After cache warm it drops to ~90ms. Documenting in #eng-infra-runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/sa-east1-registry-warmup
arjun: networking note — public IP ephemeral limits in sa-east1 : had to request quota bump for ephemeral ips for the replication runners and load balancers. Support ticket #INC-3245 opened.
maya: handoff checklist draft (short):
- GitOps: PR merged & flux health green
- Registry: replication job succeeded, cache warmed, manifest filtering set
- Nodes: GPU pool created, driver + device plugin healthy, smoke tests passed
- Networking: firewall rules, egress allowlist, ephemeral IP quota confirmed
- Cost: instance flavors approved, committed pricing discussed for Dedicated customers
- Observability: per-nodeGPU metrics visible in Datadog, logging retained 30d
- Handoff: pager + oncall rotation assigned to sa-east1 oncall
trent: I ran the smoke script — GPU test passed (torch True), node plugin shows "Healthy: true".
suhas: autoscaler policy: min 2, max 12 (mix pools), scale-down after 10m idle. I'll add recommended config to the PR.
maya: assign handoff to @lina for first-week ops run and @trent for GitOps follow-ups. Lina — you OK to own?
lina: yep, I'll own week1 ops and the registry warm-up dashboard. Adding myself to oncall rota.
deploy-bot: Pipeline: cluster-provision-sa-east1 succeeded — all hooks OK.
ops-bot: Reminder: run cost forecast script after 24h of workload to check unit token cost delta.
arjun: anything blocking final handoff?
maya: just waiting on quota bump confirmation and that ticket closure. If both green by EOD we'll mark as handed off. Thanks team :thumbsup:
